name: sx/install-guide
title: SX Install Guide
description: Step-by-step install per platform (iPhone, Google Play, APK), each ending in its install button.

guardrails: Required on any site that offers an APK (blueprint rule 'apk').
The APK column always shows the file size, version and the distribution note: why it is outside Google Play and that Android will warn.
Default steps are UI strings in every locale; content may override them per platform.
